result.note: Tests India's first-ever Captagon seizure under Operation RAGEPILL, an enforcement first with a Gulf transit angle.

questions.prompt: In May 2026, the Narcotics Control Bureau made India's first-ever interception of which drug, recovering it across Delhi and Mundra port under Operation RAGEPILL?
questions.explain: The NCB seized 227 kilograms of Captagon, valued at INR 182 crore, in the country's first interception of the drug. It uncovered an international syndicate using India as a transit corridor to the Gulf. Captagon is a psychotropic stimulant that gained notoriety during the Syrian civil war.
questions.source: The Narcotics Control Bureau (NCB) seized 227 kilograms of Captagon in the country's first-ever interception of the drug, uncovering an international syndicate using India as a transit corridor to funnel the stimulant into Gulf nations.
